integrity_notes: Exact support classification over the complex numbers and complete finite congruence enumeration have been checked. A second finite-field rank calculation checks the enumeration but is not invoked to deduce characteristic-zero geometry. Independent evaluation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the 375 distinguished crossing lines on the complex Fermat quintic, not to all Fano-scheme members or to a generic quintic. Counts distinct projective intersection points, not intersection multiplicities or intersections of parameter curves.
title: The 375 distinguished Fermat-quintic lines have 50 fifteenfold and 1875 double intersection points
